meta.descricao: Sponsor Valejas Atlético Clube: kit, banners in the sports hall, digital content, support for an age group or sports patronage. Request the partnership pack and receive it by email.

cabecalho.texto: {anos} years as a club, {modalidades} sports and a sports hall full of people every day of the week. Tell us who you are and get the Valejas partnership pack in your inbox straight away — with everything the club has to offer.
cabecalho.verApoios: See who already supports the club

marca.texto: From the kit the athletes wear to the walls of the sports hall, which hosts training and matches from 5 pm to 11 pm on weekdays and all day at weekends — the club estimates more than 3,000 people a week. All the formats and prices are in the pack.

equipamentos.descricao: Your brand on the match kit, the training kit and tracksuit, the travel wear or the bibs.

pavilhao.nome: Banners and vinyl in the sports hall
pavilhao.descricao: Permanent advertising on the walls and floor, in full view of those who train, play and watch.

digital.descricao: Your logo on match posters and on the club's social media posts.

caderneta.descricao: A spot in the club's sticker album, which passes from hand to hand around the area.

escalao.nome: Support an age group or sport
escalao.descricao: Back a specific team — the youngest futsal players, athletics, karate.

material.descricao: Instead of money, what your business does: transport, meals, building work, printing.

donativo.descricao: A donation to the club, which may qualify for tax benefits under the sports patronage scheme.

outro.descricao: Have a proposal that doesn't fit here? Tell us in your message.

quem.texto: A company, a local shop or a private individual — everyone counts.

apresentacao.texto: A PDF about the club, its sports and every way to support it, with prices.

contacto.texto: The club's communications team receives your request and gets in touch to sort out the rest.

fecho.texto: Would you rather talk to someone at the club first? Write to us through the contact form, with the subject «Partnership or sponsorship proposal».

formulario.entidadeDica: If you are supporting as an individual, leave this blank.
formulario.emailDica: This is where we send the pack.
formulario.tiposLegenda: How would you like to support us *
formulario.tiposDica: You can choose more than one. The prices for each are in the pack.
formulario.mensagemPlaceholder: What you have in mind, which team you'd like to support, the best time to talk…
formulario.rgpd: I authorise Valejas Atlético Clube to use this data to send me the partnership pack and to contact me about supporting the club. The data is sent by email and is not stored on the website. <link>Privacy Policy</link> (in Portuguese). *
formulario.pdfNaHora: PDF sent to your email, straight away.

feito.enviada: The partnership pack is on its way to <forte>{email}</forte>. It should arrive within minutes — if you can't see it, check your spam or promotions folder.

feito.contacto: The club's communications team already knows you're interested and will be in touch. In the meantime, for any questions: <link>{email}</link>.
